snippet.title: The Croaker 1.7: The Largest Update Since The Game's Release
snippet.description:
This will most likely remain the largest update in the game's history. I do NOT plan to ever make an update this large ever again. it took 8 months to make, with development starting on April 16th 2025 and ending on December 31st 2025 (~260 days). 

Offical Release Date: January 1st, 2026

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Download The Croaker 1.7: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2920070/The_Croaker/?beta=0

Join the Discord to get access to the devlog: https://discord.gg/rfRmpZz7dP
